properties.name: Feedback on reflow2 from any project is computed from a record the server kept, never from the agent's recollection
properties.statement:
Anthony, 2026-09-12, promoting `dec:idea-slash-feedback-emits-a-computed-tally-not-an-agents-recollection`: *"What if instead, I just typed /feedback and the agent just provided me a specific tally of which tools were used and which failures it experienced. Then it isn't subjective to the agent or limited by what the agent remembers from the current session (and past sessions). This could be a more automatic feedback for all reflow2 projects (should also have all the metadata like which agent, which OS, which agentic platform, etc)."*

THE REQUIREMENT. On any project reflow2 serves, a person can type `/feedback` and receive a report whose spine is COMPUTED from a record the server itself kept of every tool call it answered — which tools were called and how often, which calls were refused or failed and under which class of refusal, which skills were fetched, which served tools were never touched — together with the metadata the server can know without asking anybody: reflow2's version, the operating system, the harness that connected (name and version, from the handshake), the protocol revision, and the size of the design. The one field the server cannot know, the model behind the agent, is carried as the agent's self-report and labelled as such.

WHAT THE RECORD MAY CARRY, AND MAY NOT. The line is `req:telemetry-carries-usage-never-design-content`, unchanged: tool name, skill name, outcome class, duration, timestamp — yes. Node ids, statements, search queries, tool arguments, error text that could quote the user's design — never. A refusal is recorded as its CLASS (near-match, missing argument, unknown argument, unresolved reference, refused, error), never as its message.

WHAT THE UNIT IS. The record is per PROJECT — one ledger beside the design's store, appended by every session that serves that design, whatever harness or agent it came from — and a report covers everything since the previous report (or since a date the person names), not "this session". That is deliberate: the request was for feedback not limited to what one agent remembers of one session, and a project's ledger is the only thing that sees every session equally.

WHAT THE AGENT STILL DOES. It annotates, it does not recollect: each refusal row invites one line of disposition (guard working / real defect / unexplained) and any reproduction the agent has. The subjective part is bounded to rows the server chose.

WHAT LEAVES THE MACHINE. Nothing, unless the person carries it. The report is written into the project's own feedback file for the person to read and send on — `req:agent-authored-feedback-is-reproducible-and-never-leaves-unasked` holds: typing `/feedback` is the consent to compose it, not the consent to send it.

HONEST LIMIT. The ledger sees only reflow2's own tool calls. A `gh` error, a shell pipe, a red CI happen outside its sight; for those the agent remains the only witness and `report-friction` remains the form.
